paper.title_en: T-duality of string charge density/bit threads correspondence in type II supergravity
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we study Abelian T-duality of the string charge density/bit threads correspondence in ten-dimensional Type II supergravity. T-duality along the common compact circle maps the Type IIB F1-NS5-P background to a Type IIA P-NS5-F1 background with the winding and momentum charges exchanged. The radial F1 source remains an F1 source, and its projected charge density gives a bit-thread flow whose maximal flux reproduces the black hole entropy. The same duality maps D1-D5-P to D0-D4-F1. In this case, a radial D1 source becomes a D2 source wrapped on the dual circle. Contracting the resulting spatial bivector with the normalized closed one-form on that circle gives a conserved effective radial flow whose maximal flux again reproduces the entropy. Although the local metrics, dilatons, source currents, and flow norms change, the dilaton-weighted transverse area density and the integrated maximal flux are invariant. These results provide a nontrivial T-duality test of the correspondence and extend it from string currents to wrapped-brane currents that reduce to string-like flows.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究十维 II 型超引力中弦荷密度/比特线对应（bit threads correspondence）的 Abelian T-对偶，属于黑洞熵与全息纠缠相关的理论物理课题。摘要具体给出 T-对偶下 F1-NS5-P 与 P-NS5-F1、D1-D5-P 与 D0-D4-F1 的映射，并说明最大流量再现黑洞熵，方法上具有可检验性，理论深度与新颖性较高，适合点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: II 型超引力中弦荷密度/比特线对应的 T-对偶
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究十维 II 型超引力中弦荷密度/比特线对应的 Abelian T-对偶。沿公共紧致圆的 T-对偶将 IIB 型 F1-NS5-P 背景映射为 IIA 型 P-NS5-F1 背景，其中绕数与动量荷发生交换。径向 F1 源仍然是一个 F1 源，其投影荷密度给出一个比特线流，该流的最大流量再现了黑洞熵。同样的对偶将 D1-D5-P 映射为 D0-D4-F1。在这种情况下，一个径向 D1 源变为缠绕在对偶圆上的 D2 源。将由此得到的空间双矢量与该圆上归一化闭一卷形式缩并，给出一个守恒的有效径向流，其最大流量再次再现了熵。尽管局部度规、伸缩子、源流和流的范数发生变化，但伸缩子加权的横向面积密度与积分最大流量是不变的。这些结果为该对应提供了非平凡的 T-对偶检验，并将其从弦流扩展到约化为弦状流的缠绕膜流。
